mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are waking up to a mild 73 degrees with a light drizzle falling near Fireman's Park, making it feel like 75 degrees.

In city sustainability news, Verona is reminding apartment residents that they can participate in home composting by utilizing the Badger Prairie Food Scrap Stop on East Verona Avenue. Additionally, the city is continuing its eco-friendly efforts by installing anti-idling technology on its new ambulance and earning recognition as a Bronze Level Bicycle Friendly Community.

Looking ahead to this weekend, the Dane County Farmer's Market takes place on Saturday, July 18th, alongside live music at Paddy Mac's and the Mount Horeb Art Fair. Also, mark your calendars for next Wednesday, July 22nd, for the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park.

In the weekly police report, on Thursday, July 9th, officers responded to a two-vehicle crash at County Highway PB and American Way where a driver failed to yield the right of way, resulting in minor injuries and a citation.

If you are craving a sweet treat, today's flavor of the day at Culver's is Mint Cookie. Since the doors are currently closed, you will have to wait until they open at 10:00 AM, or you can plan ahead for tomorrow's delicious Turtle flavor.
